name: Pre-registration
requirement: Rule text, sample window and gates committed before the evaluation window opens; the commit hash is the registration.
status_this_desk: Every family in strategies.csv carries a frozen rule and a commit hash.

name: Sample size
requirement: n >= 300 graded bets before any family may be ranked on the certification board.
status_this_desk: 2026 has 145 completed games; no family is close. This gate fails for every family by construction.

name: Official price at timestamp
requirement: Both an opening and a closing price with a timestamp, from an official or licensed source, for every graded bet.
status_this_desk: Zero prices exist. Fails for every family (F-01).

name: Proper score vs benchmark
requirement: Brier skill against the published benchmark, with a cluster-robust lower bound above zero.
status_this_desk: Not computable while no benchmark price exists; only the binomial interval is computable today.

name: Walk-forward
requirement: The rule must hold out of sample on chronological folds, not just in sample.
threshold: PASS if out-of-sample not worse than in-sample beyond its interval
status_this_desk: Fold structure exists (weeks 1-9 train, week 10 holdout); the window is too short to certify.

name: Multiplicity
requirement: Holm-Bonferroni across the family of strategies tested in one run.
status_this_desk: Computed for all ten families on every run.

name: Calibration
requirement: Forecast probability must match observed frequency within its interval (reliability diagram bands).
threshold: PASS if the 95% band contains the identity
status_this_desk: Computed for the margin and totals models.

name: Joint evidence (parlays and prop combos)
requirement: A directly validated joint probability plus the operator's void/push rules before any combination is ranked.
status_this_desk: Zero validated joints and zero operator rules. Both divisions are empty by design.

name: Leakage
requirement: No feature may use information timestamped after the price it is compared against.
status_this_desk: All inputs are stamped before kickoff of the week they price; the check runs on every rebuild.
